PROP-stem-system-inv-009.text: OAuth redirect cookie must be httpOnly with sameSite=lax and maxAge=600s.
PROP-stem-system-inv-009.assertion: forall cookie: oauth_redirect_cookie.httpOnly == true AND cookie.sameSite == 'lax' AND cookie.maxAge <= 600

locations.note: Sets oauth_redirect cookie with httpOnly:true, secure:true, sameSite:'lax', maxAge:600
